long.en: Governance of cultural data — consent frameworks, provenance documentation, repatriation policy design, and legal review of cultural data collection, use, and sharing.

problem.en: Unclear provenance and access rights enable unauthorized cultural reuse.
problem.fr: Unclear provenance and access rights enable unauthorized cultural reuse.
problem.ar: Unclear provenance and access rights enable unauthorized cultural reuse.

solution.en: Provenance register, consent/access controls, and repatriation or restitution protocols.

acceptance_boundary.en: access audits and tested restriction/revocation workflows. Cultural data is not automatically public or commercially reusable.
